headline: FDR on raising *prices* and maintaining dollar purchasing power
quote: we shall seek to establish and maintain a dollar
title: FDR, 1933: Restoring price levels to stabilize dollar purchasing power
caption: During his October 1933 fireside chat, President Roosevelt committed to restoring commodity prices across all agricultural goods. He stated that the ultimate goal was to maintain a stable purchasing power for future generations.
comment: Can government policy effectively stabilize long-term currency purchasing power?
